model_annotation: Figure 2 is a bar chart illustrating the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between the baseline Mistral-v0.2 model and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty dataset. The chart has a horizontal category axis labeled "Per-specialty terms" with six categories representing different clinical specialties, listed in the same order. The vertical value axis is labeled with a range from approximately -8 to 0, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. Each category on the horizontal axis is represented by a group of bars, with each bar colored differently to signify tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. The height of the bars varies, with some bars being significantly taller than others within the same group, indicating different log-probability values. The bars are grouped by specialty, and the colors differentiate the tokens within each group. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within the groups, and there is no visual emphasis on particular bars.
